title: The Tabernacle is Erected and the Glory of the Lord Fills It
description: The Lord commands Moses to erect the tabernacle on the first day of the first month. Moses sets up the tent of meeting, places the ark, the table, the lampstand, the golden altar, the bronze altar, and the basin, and erects the courtyard. Aaron and his sons are consecrated for priestly service. When the work is completed, the cloud covers the tent of meeting and the glory of the Lord fills the tabernacle. The cloud then leads the Israelites onward on their journey.

versions.title: The Tabernacle is Built
versions.description: Moses erects the tabernacle according to the Lord's instructions, places all the furnishings in their proper positions, and the glory of the Lord fills the tabernacle in the form of a cloud.
